about_the_game:
You are a security guard of the SCP Foundation, assigned to Site-8182 beneath an old Japanese mansion.

Your mission was simple: keep watch…

Until SCP-163-JP broke free.

Now, trapped inside the underground labs and the house above, you must gain Level D clearance and force the entity back into its containment chamber—before it tears you apart.

Game Features:

  • Psychological Horror – tension, dread, and the constant fight to survive.

  • A Unique SCP Entity – SCP-163-JP drives its victims insane. It can’t be tracked by radar or sensors—only seen with your own eyes.

  • Inventory & Documents – collect items and uncover files that reveal chilling details about SCP-163-JP.

  • Survival & Stealth – hide, run, and find a way to contain the anomaly before it’s too late.

  • Expansive Setting – explore a sprawling traditional Japanese mansion and the secret SCP labs beneath it.

  • Story-Driven Suspense – you are just a guard caught in the middle of a containment disaster. Doing the impossible is your only chance to survive.

Return SCP-163-JP to its chamber… or become its next victim.
